name: Long-tailed vole
desc: Long-tailed vole (Microtus longicaudus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 57 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The long-tailed vole, in some areas known as the San Bernardino long-tailed vole, is a small vole found in western North America. They have short ears and a long tail.
